name: POST /api/leadflow/audit/evidence-bundle - everything about one subject
description:
Assembles audit events, consent receipts and source assertions for one subject.

ASSEMBLED ON DEMAND rather than stored. A bundle is requested because somebody is answering a question NOW — a complaint, a rights request, a dispute — and a pre-built one is stale by definition and reassuring by accident.

A REASON IS REQUIRED: pulling somebody's whole record together is itself an auditable act, and the bundle records its own assembly.

A PARTIAL BUNDLE SAYS SO, prominently. Handing somebody an incomplete record labelled complete is worse than handing them nothing, because they answer a regulator from it. QA: measured live — the refusal, and a bundle correctly reporting complete:false with all three sections unavailable.

testCases.name: The bundle reports each section and whether it is complete
A bundle with no stated reason is REFUSED
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: reason is required - an evidence bundle assembles somebody's whole record, and why it was assembled is itself an auditable act
Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
